incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INCIDENT_KEY=INC-19777 — Service: inference-serving — Trigger: error rate > 8% across prod-east clusters. Escalation policy: primary_oncall -> secondary_oncall (5m) -> manager (10m). PD link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-19777

pagerduty-bot: Assigned to samantha (primary_oncall). Notification: pagerduty mobile push + SMS.

samantha: on it, just woke up. checking dashboards now. anyone seeing customer impact?

li: seeing 502 spikes from frontend -> inference gateway, started ~10:12 UTC. ~35% of requests failing on tokenization stage? Not on model timeout.

emily: metrics show latency still ok for successful requests but error_count up across vpc-prod-east-3 pod group. looks like a model loader error repeated. adding logs to the thread:```
ERROR 2025-07-04T10:12:18Z model_loader: failed to mmap quantized weights: EINVAL
Traceback ...
```

incident-bot: Reminder: if primary doesn't acknowledge within 5m, policy will escalate to secondary. (escalation countdown: 04:30)

samantha: hmm I don't have privileges to access that host directly from phone. can someone ssh and restart the model process?

marco: I'm oncall for infra (secondary) — will try a soft restart on affected nodes. grabbing creds and runbook.

runbook-bot: Runbook snippet: ``sudo systemctl restart redwood-inference && tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/inference.log`` If restart fails, use `systemctl stop && systemctl start` and escalate to infra-eng.

(5 minutes pass)

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: Alert escalated to secondary_oncall (marco). PD note: primary did not acknowledge in window. Notification sent to marco.

marco: acked on behalf of secondary. running restart on prod-east-3-2 now. will monitor. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

(30s later)

marco: restart returned nonzero, looks like inode corruption while mmapping. copying logs to /tmp/INC-19777-logs.tar.gz and mounting scratch. starting fallback: switch traffic to replica pool (prod-east-1/2) via routing toggle. 

samantha: thanks, are we steering traffic automatically? what's the customer impact delta?

li: routing toggle up: 40% of traffic shifted off prod-east-3 to replicas. Error rate on affected frontend drops from 35% -> 6% within 1m. Customer visible errors reduced but there is increase in p99 latency (~200ms).

samantha: ok that buys us time. continue trying to bring nodes back. I'll notify support to hold chat escalations: @support-team please add note "mitigated: partial routing fallback in place; increased latency for some requests"

emily: support notified.

(5 more minutes pass)

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: Manager escalation fired (manager_jay) due to no primary ack within 10m of initial alert. Notification sent to manager_jay.

manager_jay: acked and joining. thanks for the quick mitigation. want a short blameless summary in 30m. are backups ok? any data loss concerns?

marco: no data loss. model checkpoints and KV caches preserved. root cause looks like corrupted mmap segments on a subset of GPUs after nightly maintenance job. collecting artifacts now.

samantha: I'm back on laptop now — confirmed we should keep routing fallback on until we replace affected hosts. can we spin up replacement nodes in same AZ and rehydrate cache?

marco: spinning new instances (fleet scale +2) and pre-warming model cache. command run:```
redwood infra create-instances --count 2 --zone prod-east-3 --type g6-standard
# then prewarm script
/opt/redwood/bin/prewarm_model.sh --model rdx-encoder-v2 --target /var/cache/rdx
```

li: monitoring prewarm progress. once cache is loaded we can cut traffic back incrementally. ETA ~14m.

manager_jay: good. Emily, Samantha, please draft a short customer-facing blurb we can put on status.redwood.ai. Focus: partial service impact, mitigation in place, no data loss, ETA for full restore.

emily: drafting now. propose: "We experienced elevated error rates for text generation in the us-east region starting at 10:12 UTC. Traffic was partially rerouted to healthy replicas; errors reduced and no data loss observed. Engineers are replacing affected hosts; full traffic restoration expected within 30 minutes."

samantha: LGTM. post when you have it and I'll approve.

(12 minutes later)

marco: new instances up, cache prewarm finished. running healthcheck and will reintroduce 10% traffic increments over 6 steps.

li: health checks green. switching +10%.

(3 minutes)

li: error rate down to baseline ~1.1%. p99 latency settling. continuing to scale traffic back.

samantha: marking incident as mitigated in PD and posting de-escalation note. acking closure after confirm.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-19777 status: Mitigated -> Acknowledged by samantha. Closing window will be open for postmortem. PD link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-19777

manager_jay: thanks everyone. great coordination. please add timeline + root cause + remediation to the postmortem doc. assign owner for follow-up (marco).

marco: taking owner for postmortem. will include action: disable risky nightly maintenance that touches mmap patterns, add MMAP integrity check, and improve oncall mobile ACLs so primary can ack from phone.

samantha: +1 on ACLs and runbook clarity. add note to runbook about fallback toggle command and safe rollback steps.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived. For follow-up, create a postmortem and tag #postmortems and @manager_jay. :white_check_mark:
